publication_safety.privacy_opinion: Public text stays inside paper-mode percentages of a virtual basis, empty positions, trade counts, and ticker-level process notes. No account or order identifiers, absolute dollars, balances, NLV, prices, share counts, or paired position-level percentages that would reconstruct sizing.
publication_safety.statistical_opinion: The entry is statistically honest: n=2 standard closes, both losses, one execution-contaminated path, incomplete exit telemetry on the other, zero qualified observation-ledger rows, and explicit separation of pre-trigger failures, fill-model-dependent shadows, capability-blocked outcomes, and cross-epoch basis. Contaminated and tiny samples are framed as integrity defects, not alpha.

strategy_critique.opinion: The book is not showing edge; it is showing process failure under a reclaim monoculture. Halting new aggressive entries, locking size, refusing ledger-empty promotion, and forcing causal-fill plus quote-integrity receipts is the correct posture. Standard reclaim may keep unchanged controls only as a non-promoted paper lane; it has not earned belief. Sector-pair relative-value is the right highest-priority distinct shadow family. Measurement infrastructure before strategy judgment is non-negotiable.
strategy_critique.mechanism_overlap: Pooled level/VWAP reclaim still absorbs day-two continuation, negative-catalyst reclaim, and most recent sampled names into one completed-bar break/reclaim-plus-confirmation mechanism. Same-session clusters are correlated evidence, not independent trials. Lane labels are not diversification while non-reclaim families remain at zero qualified rows.
missed_alternatives: Quality large-cap three-lower-close mean reversion with a magnitude arm and random same-universe control
Post-event gap-fill reversion kept strictly separate from day-two continuation
Cross-sectional multi-week momentum with versioned universe, skip, and cost model
Earnings implied-move mispricing only after causal prior-close option snapshot coverage is proven

current_strategy_grades.name: Pooled level and VWAP reclaim
current_strategy_grades.reason: Contaminated exit path, overnight noise-scale stop fragility, empty qualified ledger, and mechanism monoculture. Keep unchanged standard controls only under the aggressive halt; no promotion, tuning, or unlock evidence from current rows.

current_strategy_grades.name: Sector-pair relative-value reversion
current_strategy_grades.reason: Genuinely less index-like residual mechanism and the correct under-sampled priority; remains shadow-only with frozen registry, controls, and kill rules.

current_strategy_grades.name: Observation round-trip and gate counterfactuals
current_strategy_grades.reason: Binding defect is evidence throughput and same-timestamp control validity, not another alpha label. Measurement-only; gate counterfactuals must never auto-loosen hard gates.

current_strategy_grades.name: Index or sector put continuation
current_strategy_grades.reason: Zero qualifying index/sector observations; single-name references do not count. Capability collection only, no paper order authority.

bounded_recommendations.name: Causal fill and quote-integrity gate before any reclaim scoring
bounded_recommendations.frozen_setup: Count only broker-causal fills with timestamped bid/ask/last, quote age, spread-to-risk, trigger source, and rejection of trade-dislocated, zero-sided, crossed, or stale quotes; cluster same-session reclaim names as one cohort.
bounded_recommendations.benchmark_or_control: Contaminated or incomplete-telemetry exits as excluded diagnostics versus clean causal-fill cohort; matched same-timestamp cash or non-trigger control.
bounded_recommendations.minimum_sample: 2 completed sessions for plumbing; 20 clean filled pooled reclaim outcomes before any demotion/promotion review; 10 matched-control pairs with geometry fidelity audit.
bounded_recommendations.promotion_rule: None in this cycle. Scoring may resume only after plumbing success and conservative mean R > 0 on clean fills with control coverage >= 95%.
bounded_recommendations.kill_rule: Any empty expectancy snapshot while registrations exist, backfilled control, or quote-integrity failure freezes strategy scoring and keeps new aggressive entries halted.

bounded_recommendations.name: Sector-pair relative-value reversion shadow priority
bounded_recommendations.frozen_setup: Versioned liquid sector-pair registry; 20-session residual/z-score; entry |z| >= 2.0; exit |z| <= 0.5 or five sessions; beta-neutral notional math; news flag; non-overlapping episodes; complete no-signal scan receipts.
bounded_recommendations.benchmark_or_control: Unhedged laggard leg, SPY over the same window, and sub-threshold same-pair crossings.
bounded_recommendations.minimum_sample: 40 non-overlapping episodes across at least four frozen pairs.
bounded_recommendations.promotion_rule: Conservative hedged mean R > +0.10 versus controls, abs SPY correlation < 0.30, and no pair > 30% of positive R earns paper-executable review only.
bounded_recommendations.kill_rule: Mean R <= 0, abs SPY correlation > 0.40, sign flip after removing best pair at n=40, or 5+5 no-signal scan infeasibility retires the threshold set or family.

bounded_recommendations.name: Gate-counterfactual ledger
bounded_recommendations.frozen_setup: When entry logic fires and a deterministic gate blocks it, prospectively register blocked geometry with gate name, causal fill convention, unchanged stop/target/horizon, and session cluster ID; no retroactive rows; no orders.
bounded_recommendations.benchmark_or_control: Accepted same-family setups with identical geometry and horizon; report accepted mean R minus blocked mean R by gate.
bounded_recommendations.minimum_sample: 15 resolved counterfactuals per gate and >= 80% resolvability.
bounded_recommendations.promotion_rule: A gate is evidence-supported if blocked paths underperform accepted setups by at least 0.15R conservatively; result may trigger owner/governor review only.
bounded_recommendations.kill_rule: >20% unresolvable rows kills the ledger implementation; no result may automatically loosen risk, endpoint, sizing, liquidity, or integrity controls.

disagreements_to_preserve: Fable: reclaim can remain cheap continuing research under standard controls once integrity tooling exists.
Grok: reclaim should stay shadow-primary until clean causal fills, quote integrity, and matched controls exist; contaminated exits teach execution lessons, not edge.
Unlock sample dissent: stricter long-horizon close count versus shorter owner directive remains an unresolved migration gate; size stays locked either way.

result.summary: PASS both tracks. Public candidate is privacy-safe and statistically non-claiming; strategy posture correctly halts aggressive entries, locks sizing, treats reclaim as unproven monoculture, and confines learning to bounded paper/shadow measurement without order or risk-gate authority.
